source: Ace OS starter: the default sections for a new brain. Rename, add or remove topics as your work takes shape (keep every slug unique; a note whose home disappears falls back to Needs a home).

sections.name: Your business
sections.scope: Who you are, what your business does and sells, how it runs, and the people you work with.

topics.name: About you and your business
topics.scope: Your role, what the business does, its offer, goals and how it runs day to day.
topics.why: about you, your business, its offer or how it operates

topics.name: Your team and partners
topics.scope: The people you work with, who owns what, and how you work together.
topics.why: about a person on your team or a partner and how you work with them

sections.name: Clients and projects
sections.scope: The work itself: each client or customer, and each project in flight with its state and next step.

topics.name: Clients and customers
topics.scope: One client or customer per note or group of notes: what they need, what was agreed, what was delivered.
topics.why: about a specific client or customer

topics.name: Projects and resume points
topics.scope: Multi-session projects: current state, decisions, where to resume.
topics.why: about a project in flight, its decisions or where to pick it up

sections.name: How Claude works
sections.scope: The machinery: hooks and gates, the memory system and wrap-ups, agents and workflows, skills.

topics.name: Hooks and gates
topics.scope: What the global and workspace hooks do, how to write, wire, scope and trust a hook.
topics.why: about a Claude Code hook, a gate, or the auto-mode safety checks

topics.name: Memory, wrap-ups and session history
topics.scope: How the brain stores, files and finds notes; the wrap-up pass; temp logs; transcripts and history.
topics.why: about the memory system, recall, the sitemap, wrap-up or session history

topics.name: Agents, sessions and workflows
topics.scope: Subagents, multi-agent workflows, parallel sessions and how to tell what a session is doing.
topics.why: about agents, workflows, delegation or running sessions

topics.name: Skills and playbooks
topics.scope: Using and building skills (repeatable procedures Claude runs on command).
topics.why: about running or building a skill

sections.name: Checking work
sections.scope: What counts as proof: the standards, how to build gates that really bite, and how to check what things look like.

topics.name: The proof standards
topics.scope: The rules for claiming done, works, fixed or verified.
topics.why: a standard for proving work is done

topics.name: Gates that really bite
topics.scope: How to build, test and trust automated checks, and the ways they pass when they should fail.
topics.why: about building or trusting a gate, test or check

topics.name: Look at it
topics.scope: Render and read: screenshots, breakpoints, interaction checks for pages and dashboards.
topics.why: about verifying how something looks or behaves on screen

sections.name: Ace OS
sections.scope: The Ace OS shell: the dashboard (Mission Control), the 3D brain view, the sitemap page, install and settings.

topics.name: Dashboard and brain view
topics.scope: How the dashboard and the brain view work, their panels, the opt-in chat, and changing them safely.
topics.why: about the Ace OS dashboard, the brain view or the sitemap page

topics.name: Install, update and settings
topics.scope: Installing and updating Ace OS, settings.json, the config folder, and turning parts on or off.
topics.why: about installing, updating or configuring Ace OS

sections.name: Your rules for me
sections.scope: How you want Claude to work with you: how to talk, what scope to keep, how to hand things over.

topics.name: How to talk to you and decide
topics.scope: Tone, format, when to ask and when to decide, how to close a session.
topics.why: a rule about how Claude should talk to you or decide

topics.name: Do exactly what was asked
topics.scope: Scope rules: what to change, what to leave alone, when to ask before acting.
topics.why: a rule about scope or permission

topics.name: How to hand you things
topics.scope: How you want results, files, links and summaries delivered.
topics.why: a rule about how to deliver work to you

sections.name: Machines and tools
sections.scope: Your computers, terminal and shells, and the quirks of the tools Claude uses on them.

topics.name: Your computer and terminal
topics.scope: Operating system, terminal, shells, folders and how sessions are started.
topics.why: about your machine, terminal or where sessions start

topics.name: Tool quirks
topics.scope: Traps in git, Node, browsers, file formats and other tools, and portable paths.
topics.why: about a tool's quirk or a portability trap

inbox.name: Unsorted: needs a home
inbox.scope: New notes the filing step could not place. Shown at the top of the sitemap until someone files them.
